turns.question: Which customer had the highest revenue in 2016, with their number, name and revenue?
turns.sql: SELECT TOP 1 i.BillToCustomerID AS MUSTERI_ID, c.CustomerName AS MUSTERI_ADI, SUM(il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount) AS CIRO FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID JOIN Sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerID = i.BillToCustomerID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 AND i.InvoiceDate >= '2016-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2017-01-01' GROUP BY i.BillToCustomerID, c.CustomerName ORDER BY CIRO DESC, i.BillToCustomerID

turns.question: How many orders did this customer place in 2016?
turns.sql: SELECT COUNT(o.OrderID) AS SIPARIS FROM Sales.Orders o WHERE o.CustomerID = (SELECT TOP 1 i.BillToCustomerID FROM Sales.Invoices i JOIN Sales.InvoiceLines il ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 AND i.InvoiceDate >= '2016-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2017-01-01' GROUP BY i.BillToCustomerID ORDER BY SUM(il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount) DESC, i.BillToCustomerID)

turns.question: Which stock item sold the most units in 2016, with its number, name and units sold?
turns.sql: SELECT TOP 1 il.StockItemID AS URUN_ID, si.StockItemName AS URUN_ADI, SUM(il.Quantity) AS SATILAN_ADET FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID JOIN Warehouse.StockItems si ON si.StockItemID = il.StockItemID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 AND i.InvoiceDate >= '2016-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2017-01-01' GROUP BY il.StockItemID, si.StockItemName ORDER BY SATILAN_ADET DESC, il.StockItemID

turns.question: Which stock groups is this product in?
turns.sql: SELECT sg.StockGroupName AS STOK_GRUBU FROM Warehouse.StockItemStockGroups sig JOIN Warehouse.StockGroups sg ON sg.StockGroupID = sig.StockGroupID WHERE sig.StockItemID = (SELECT TOP 1 il.StockItemID FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 AND i.InvoiceDate >= '2016-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2017-01-01' GROUP BY il.StockItemID ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity) DESC, il.StockItemID) ORDER BY sg.StockGroupName

turns.question: Show as bar chart
turns.sql: SELECT sg.StockGroupName AS STOK_GRUBU FROM Warehouse.StockItemStockGroups sig JOIN Warehouse.StockGroups sg ON sg.StockGroupID = sig.StockGroupID WHERE sig.StockItemID = (SELECT TOP 1 il.StockItemID FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 AND i.InvoiceDate >= '2016-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2017-01-01' GROUP BY il.StockItemID ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity) DESC, il.StockItemID) ORDER BY sg.StockGroupName

turns.question: Excluding credit notes, which supplier had the highest revenue, with its name and revenue?
turns.sql: SELECT TOP 1 su.SupplierName AS TEDARIKCI_ADI, SUM(il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount) AS CIRO FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID JOIN Warehouse.StockItems si ON si.StockItemID = il.StockItemID JOIN Purchasing.Suppliers su ON su.SupplierID = si.SupplierID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 GROUP BY su.SupplierName ORDER BY CIRO DESC, su.SupplierName

turns.question: How many stock items does this supplier have?
turns.sql: SELECT COUNT(si.StockItemID) AS URUN_SAYISI FROM Warehouse.StockItems si WHERE si.SupplierID = (SELECT TOP 1 su.SupplierID FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID JOIN Warehouse.StockItems si2 ON si2.StockItemID = il.StockItemID JOIN Purchasing.Suppliers su ON su.SupplierID = si2.SupplierID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 GROUP BY su.SupplierID ORDER BY SUM(il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount) DESC, su.SupplierID)

turns.question: Which invoice of 2016 had the highest revenue, with its invoice number, date and revenue?
turns.sql: SELECT TOP 1 i.InvoiceID AS FATURA_ID, i.InvoiceDate AS FATURA_TARIHI, SUM(il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount) AS CIRO FROM Sales.Invoices i JOIN Sales.InvoiceLines il ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 AND i.InvoiceDate >= '2016-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2017-01-01' GROUP BY i.InvoiceID, i.InvoiceDate ORDER BY CIRO DESC, i.InvoiceID

turns.question: What are the lines of this invoice, with the product number, quantity and amount?
turns.sql: SELECT il.StockItemID AS URUN_ID, il.Quantity AS ADET, il.ExtendedPrice AS TUTAR FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il WHERE il.InvoiceID = (SELECT TOP 1 i.InvoiceID FROM Sales.Invoices i JOIN Sales.InvoiceLines il2 ON il2.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 AND i.InvoiceDate >= '2016-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2017-01-01' GROUP BY i.InvoiceID ORDER BY SUM(il2.ExtendedPrice - il2.TaxAmount) DESC, i.InvoiceID) ORDER BY il.InvoiceLineID

turns.question: What are the 5 stock items with the highest revenue in 2016, with their names and revenue?
turns.sql: SELECT TOP 5 si.StockItemName AS URUN_ADI, SUM(il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount) AS CIRO FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID JOIN Warehouse.StockItems si ON si.StockItemID = il.StockItemID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 AND i.InvoiceDate >= '2016-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2017-01-01' GROUP BY si.StockItemName ORDER BY CIRO DESC, si.StockItemName

turns.question: Which of these brought in the most profit?
turns.sql: SELECT TOP 5 si.StockItemName AS URUN_ADI, SUM(il.LineProfit) AS KAR FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID JOIN Warehouse.StockItems si ON si.StockItemID = il.StockItemID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 AND i.InvoiceDate >= '2016-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2017-01-01' AND il.StockItemID IN (SELECT TOP 5 il2.StockItemID FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il2 JOIN Sales.Invoices i2 ON i2.InvoiceID = il2.InvoiceID WHERE i2.IsCreditNote = 0 AND i2.InvoiceDate >= '2016-01-01' AND i2.InvoiceDate < '2017-01-01' GROUP BY il2.StockItemID ORDER BY SUM(il2.ExtendedPrice - il2.TaxAmount) DESC, il2.StockItemID) GROUP BY si.StockItemName ORDER BY KAR DESC, si.StockItemName

turns.question: Show as pie chart
turns.sql: SELECT TOP 5 si.StockItemName AS URUN_ADI, SUM(il.LineProfit) AS KAR FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID JOIN Warehouse.StockItems si ON si.StockItemID = il.StockItemID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 AND i.InvoiceDate >= '2016-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2017-01-01' AND il.StockItemID IN (SELECT TOP 5 il2.StockItemID FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il2 JOIN Sales.Invoices i2 ON i2.InvoiceID = il2.InvoiceID WHERE i2.IsCreditNote = 0 AND i2.InvoiceDate >= '2016-01-01' AND i2.InvoiceDate < '2017-01-01' GROUP BY il2.StockItemID ORDER BY SUM(il2.ExtendedPrice - il2.TaxAmount) DESC, il2.StockItemID) GROUP BY si.StockItemName ORDER BY KAR DESC, si.StockItemName

turns.question: What is the monthly sales revenue excluding VAT across all years?
turns.sql: SELECT YEAR(i.InvoiceDate) AS YIL, MONTH(i.InvoiceDate) AS AY, SUM(il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount) AS CIRO FROM Sales.Invoices i JOIN Sales.InvoiceLines il ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 GROUP BY YEAR(i.InvoiceDate), MONTH(i.InvoiceDate) ORDER BY YIL, AY

turns.question: Only the year 2016
turns.sql: SELECT YEAR(i.InvoiceDate) AS YIL, MONTH(i.InvoiceDate) AS AY, SUM(il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount) AS CIRO FROM Sales.Invoices i JOIN Sales.InvoiceLines il ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 AND i.InvoiceDate >= '2016-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2017-01-01' GROUP BY YEAR(i.InvoiceDate), MONTH(i.InvoiceDate) ORDER BY YIL, AY

turns.question: What is the revenue of the invoices sent by each delivery method in 2016, by method name?
turns.sql: SELECT dm.DeliveryMethodName AS YONTEM, SUM(il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount) AS CIRO FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID JOIN Application.DeliveryMethods dm ON dm.DeliveryMethodID = i.DeliveryMethodID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 AND i.InvoiceDate >= '2016-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2017-01-01' GROUP BY dm.DeliveryMethodName ORDER BY dm.DeliveryMethodName

turns.question: Only the 'Courier' and 'Delivery Van' methods
turns.sql: SELECT dm.DeliveryMethodName AS YONTEM, SUM(il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount) AS CIRO FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID JOIN Application.DeliveryMethods dm ON dm.DeliveryMethodID = i.DeliveryMethodID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 AND i.InvoiceDate >= '2016-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2017-01-01' AND dm.DeliveryMethodName IN ('Courier', 'Delivery Van') GROUP BY dm.DeliveryMethodName ORDER BY dm.DeliveryMethodName

turns.question: How many customer cards belong to the 'Tailspin Toys' buying group?
turns.sql: SELECT COUNT(c.CustomerID) AS MUSTERI FROM Sales.Customers c JOIN Sales.BuyingGroups bg ON bg.BuyingGroupID = c.BuyingGroupID WHERE bg.BuyingGroupName = 'Tailspin Toys'

turns.question: And the total number of customers?
turns.sql: SELECT COUNT(c.CustomerID) AS MUSTERI_KARTI FROM Sales.Customers c

turns.question: What is the total revenue of this group excluding VAT in 2016?
turns.sql: SELECT SUM(il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount) AS CIRO FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID JOIN Sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerID = i.BillToCustomerID JOIN Sales.BuyingGroups bg ON bg.BuyingGroupID = c.BuyingGroupID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 AND i.InvoiceDate >= '2016-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2017-01-01' AND bg.BuyingGroupName = 'Tailspin Toys'
